content: List the top 10 countries, where the most customers are from, along with their count
SELECT TOP 10 country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC
SELECT TOP 10 country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC
SELECT TOP 10 country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count ASC
